name: ModelVariant678Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant678us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a bubble rises from the model's joint along an arc while a ring of spray sprites drifts out from the same point, then bursts into an animated sprite, sixteen shards and eight expanding rings); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs eleven texture images and seeds the bubbles, bursts, sprays and delay from the command row indexed by the request; every call then counts down the delay or runs one frame, returning 4 while a burst is active, 1 on the first frame that finds every element inactive, 2 on later such frames and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-695 and 762 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
